name: io.github.mohammad-emad-dev/diagrams-mcp-server
title: Diagrams MCP Server
description: Local-first MCP server for PlantUML and Mermaid diagrams with drift detection.

environmentVariables.name: PROJECT_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Project root to attach to (defaults to the working directory).

environmentVariables.name: DIAGRAMS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Diagrams directory, relative to PROJECT_ROOT unless absolute (default: diagrams).

environmentVariables.name: PLANTUML_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override for the opt-in remote PlantUML fallback.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_REMOTE_PLANTUML
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to allow the remote PlantUML fallback when no local CLI is installed.

environmentVariables.name: DISABLE_REMOTE_PLANTUML
environmentVariables.description: Set to true to always disable the remote PlantUML fallback.
